tasks.subject: Task 17: sim.py — the wall is the fallback surface
tasks.description:
**Goal:** When repel is held and no node is in reach, the player pushes off the nearer wall. This removes the unlucky death.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/gravi/sim.py`
- Test: `tests/test_sim.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `World` takes `wall_reach`, default 260.0
- [ ] Repel with no node in reach pushes away from the nearer wall
- [ ] A node in range wins — wall force is not added on top
- [ ] Beyond the reach, repel does nothing
- [ ] A player crossing a turn at full speed with no node in reach can change trajectory before the wall
- [ ] Attract unaffected

tasks.subject: Task 18: sim.py — repel costs a rechargeable charge
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Repel drains a rechargeable budget, so it is a timing decision rather than a button to hold.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/gravi/sim.py`, `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-11-gravi-core-design.md`
- Test: `tests/test_sim.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Full tank at start, `repel_charges` exposed
- [ ] Drains only while producing force; a press in open space is free
- [ ] A press that produced force costs at least `repel_min_spend`
- [ ] Does not fire below `repel_min_spend`
- [ ] Regen passive, pauses while draining, capped
- [ ] Attach bonus once per new latch
- [ ] `reset()` refills
- [ ] Attract costs nothing
- [ ] Core spec §2.3 carries the amendment permitting the meter

**Steps:** Eight failing tests; thread five knobs; `_open_or_continue_press`/`_end_press`; compute the force candidate BEFORE paying; attach bonus; core spec amendment. Full code in the plan, section "Task 5".
